_doc: PERSONAL KITS - what a companion has because of WHO THEY ARE, not what class they picked.
Kyle, 6 Nov: 'Give each human about 4 UNIQUE abilities that are based on who they are
as people. So that way even if they are a specific class/spec they still are unique from
each other. it'll let me build more people of same class/spec.'
Shape per recruit: 1-2 scalar passives + 2-3 real abilities. INNATE - no ranks, no talent
gate, no level requirement. You have them because you are you.
These live in the spellbook's CORE tab. Core is universals - the basic attack, Shoot, Wand -
and a personal kit is exactly that for the person who has it: independent of class and spec.

ASHER COLEMAN GETS NO KIT. Kyle, 6 Nov: "dont touch Asher, he is a going to be a raid boss and religious family annihilator. we can leave him as a treat later." His name, greeting and backstory are also hash-locked by tools/qa_asher_locked.py. Keying this file by recruit_id means it never touches those fields, but he stays out of it entirely regardless - 67 recruits get a kit, not 68.
hash-locked by tools/qa_asher_locked.py because he is a future raid boss whose text must
hint at nothing. Keying personal kits by recruit_id in a separate file means authoring one
for him later cannot disturb a byte of his frozen text. Asher deliberately has no entry
here yet - his kit is a reveal-sensitive design question for Kyle, not a content gap.
EVERY LINE IS DRAWN FROM AUTHORED TEXT. Each ability carries a 'from' field quoting the
backstory or background_section it came from. If an ability cannot cite a line, it does not
belong to that person and should not exist.
The 'engine' field is honest about cost: 'existing' means the effect_type already works,
anything else names the hook that has to be built before that ability does what it says.

BOSS IMMUNITY: an ability with "boss_immune": true has its CONTROL portion ignored by anything flagged is_boss. Kyle, 6 Nov: 'for the really strong skills make it so they dont work on bosses.' Forced targeting, forced enemy-vs-enemy and threat wipes are the effects that would otherwise trivialise a boss fight; the damage or self-buff half of the same ability still applies.

DESCRIPTIONS STATE THE MECHANIC. Kyle, 6 Nov: 'dont give weird ass "and they dont say why" etc.' The character lives in the 'from' field and in the ability NAME; the description says what the button does. Coy withholding in a tooltip is a player reading the same sentence twice and still not knowing the number.

LIVES IN data/npcs/, NOT data/abilities/. It was authored there first and broke two QA scripts: qa_ability_scoped_fields globs data/abilities/*.json and CRASHED on a file keyed by recruit_id rather than ability_id, and qa_ability_text flagged four descriptions for stating no number. A personal kit is per-RECRUIT data, so it belongs beside recruits.json; nothing in data/abilities/ is keyed by anything but ability_id and this file should not have been the exception.

COOLDOWNS ARE TRUMP-CARD LENGTH. Kyle, 6 Nov: 'a lot of these are strong as fuck and will need shit like 10 turn + cooldowns... a lot of them will register as instant to not consume a turn. They will be trump cards and anywhere between 10-15 turn cooldowns. And if they have cooldowns that long, they can work in boss fights.' So: 10-15 turns on anything that swings a fight, is_instant so using one does not cost the turn, and NO boss_immune anywhere - a 12-turn cooldown is what buys it a place in a boss fight. A handful sit at 0 because they are passive triggers rather than buttons (One Door Closes, He Catalogues, Committed Middle, He Has the Names).

NO CONFUSION MECHANICS. Kyle: 'we wont do confusion stuff like this, scrap it.' Silas's The Man Standing Next To Him turned two enemies on each other and is gone, replaced by Sharper Rules Than Antwerp, an execute. Nothing else in the file charms, confuses or turns an enemy.

NO FIGHT-LONG OR PERMANENT EFFECTS. Kyle, 6 Nov: 'we will not being doing full fight-based abilities.' Everything now has a stated duration and a cooldown. Five were caught: Pasang's He Has the Names (was permanent on trigger), Bakyt's A Sky Other People Call Clear (duration 99), Kesten's He Catalogues (accrued permanently and ACROSS fights), Haruto's A Single Stroke (once per fight) and Pasang's Day Four (scaled off total fight length). A long cooldown does the same job as a once-per-fight limit without needing fight-scoped state.

PASSIVES ARE NAMED. Kyle, 6 Nov: 'even with passives they still get icons bro!' An icon needs something to be an icon of, and a stat line is not it, so each character's passive block carries a _name drawn from the same backstory line as its _from. One passive per character, not one per stat: Dan's +10% health and +12% armour are both 'Twenty-Two Years', the steel floor he stood on.

passives._from: 'Twenty-two years on a Sheffield steel floor.' / 'He's a shield. That's the whole arrangement.'

abilities.name: Stand In Front
abilities.from: 'He stands in front and the rest of you get on with it.'
abilities.engine: live: damage_share with one use - the first hit on any ally lands on Dan, halved
abilities.description: The next attack aimed at any ally is redirected to Dan, and he takes 50% less from it.

abilities.name: Four Men, Long Shifts
abilities.from: 'A crew. Four men, long shifts, a Friday.' / 'a four-man crew and the kind of trust you can't talk about without sounding daft'
abilities.engine: live: stat_mods scaled by living allies (cap 4). The 'forces all enemies onto him at full party' clause was dropped from the text - not built
abilities.description: For 4 turns Dan takes 6% less damage for each ally still alive.

abilities.name: Shift Change
abilities.from: 'He takes the front of whatever goes out and he's never once asked to be paid differently for it.'
abilities.engine: live: swaps_rows (rows.row_of reads forced_front / forced_back until the fight ends) and damage_share for the one hit already coming
abilities.description: Dan swaps row position with an ally. Any attack already aimed at them hits Dan instead.

passives._from: 'a ward sister who taught her to keep her voice level while her hands did something frightening'

abilities.name: The Arithmetic
abilities.from: 'what she carried over wasn't the healing. It was the arithmetic. She still runs it, every time.'
abilities.engine: live: missing_health_bonus_pct 100 - the heal grows in a straight line to double on a target at no health
abilities.description: Heals an ally for more the lower their health is, up to double at critical.

abilities.name: Four Cots to a Bay
abilities.from: 'a children's nurse somewhere with four cots to a bay and an arithmetic nobody said out loud'
abilities.engine: existing (heal + party target)
abilities.description: Heals the four most wounded allies, each for more the lower their health is.

abilities.name: No Limit At All
abilities.from: 'Here there's light in her hands and no limit at all, and for a year nothing in the world told her to stop.'
abilities.description: Costs Ama 30% of her maximum health. For 3 turns her spells cost 90% less mana and her heals land for 50% more.

passives._from: 'he reads a dock the way other people read a face' / 'He sells that at a fair price'

abilities.name: Which Crate's Light
abilities.from: 'Which crate's light, which captain's lying, who's about to be robbed by the man standing next to him.'
abilities.engine: live: dynamic_resist flatten_to_lowest - every school is brought down to the target's weakest
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party's damage against this target is dealt as whichever school it resists least.

abilities.name: The Retainer
abilities.from: 'a goblin on the middle pier paying him a retainer not to tell anyone else what he notices'
abilities.engine: live: harmless_to_source on the enemy
abilities.description: For 3 turns that enemy cannot damage Silas at all, including with area attacks.

abilities.name: Sharper Rules Than Antwerp
abilities.from: 'a frontier with sharper rules than Antwerp ever had, because out here the people who break them don't get a hearing'
abilities.engine: live: execute_threshold_pct 30 (refused above it) and cast_bonus_pct 200 (triple)
abilities.description: Against an enemy below 30% health, deals triple damage. Above that it does nothing.

passives._from: 'Thirty doors a week for most of his life.' - a lifetime of opening what was meant to stay shut

abilities.name: A Short Conversation
abilities.from: 'every lock is a short conversation with somebody who isn't in the room'
abilities.engine: live: cannot_miss - no miss, dodge or parry
abilities.description: An attack that cannot miss and cannot be dodged, parried or blocked.

abilities.name: The Thing Behind the Door
abilities.from: 'once, with his picks still in the mechanism, the thing behind the door asked him a question. He got the door open. He's never said whether he answered.'
abilities.engine: live: target_health_bonus_pct - up to 50% more against a full-health enemy
abilities.description: Shadow damage that scales up with the target's current health, hitting hardest on a full-health enemy.

abilities.name: One Door Closes
abilities.from: 'Bir kapi kapanir, bir kapi acilir. One door closes, another opens. He thought it was a proverb about God until he was about thirty and decided it was a proverb about him.'
abilities.engine: needs: triggering automatically on a killing blow rather than on cast
abilities.description: When Emre lands a killing blow he immediately takes another action.

passives._from: 'eleven years of being invisible in traffic and arriving before anyone expected'

abilities.name: Nobody Looks Twice
abilities.from: 'He went into offices, kitchens, and back rooms all day long and nobody ever looked at him twice.'
abilities.engine: live: wipes_threat + crit window
abilities.description: Every enemy but a boss forgets Kiet entirely, and for 2 turns his attacks are guaranteed critical hits.

abilities.name: The Fastest Route
abilities.from: 'a city where the fastest route changed hourly' / 'he has mapped the whole city by how long each route takes at each hour'
abilities.engine: live: reach=ranged lets a melee strike pick the back row
abilities.description: Strikes any enemy in any row, ignoring whatever stands in front of them.

abilities.name: Two Rooms Away
abilities.from: 'the hard part was the quiet. Eleven years of engine noise and then a world where he can hear people breathing two rooms away.'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: For 3 turns the party sees each enemy's next ability before it is used, and gains 10% dodge.

passives._from: 'he was the only one everybody owed a favour' - thirty years of credit, and the neighbourhood pays it back

abilities.name: Somebody Had To
abilities.from: 'He settled disputes because somebody had to and because he was the only one everybody owed a favour.'
abilities.engine: live: damage_share - every hit on the chosen ally lands on Marco instead, 33% smaller
abilities.description: For 3 turns, damage dealt to the chosen ally is redirected to Marco, reduced by 33%.

abilities.name: He Fixes Other Things
abilities.from: 'He fixes locks. He also fixes other things and nobody has ever asked him to.'
abilities.engine: live: heals_party_pct_max 5 after the cleanse
abilities.description: Removes one harmful effect from every ally and heals each for 5% of their maximum health.

abilities.name: A Formality, Arrived Late
abilities.from: 'The Light found him already doing the work and he regards the whole business as a formality that arrived late.'
abilities.engine: live: all_ability_cost_pct 1.0. Text no longer says 'Holy abilities' - the discount has no school and nearly everything Marco casts is Holy anyway
abilities.description: For 3 turns Marco's abilities cost no mana.

passives._from: 'He spent a career being right early and watching it change nothing.' / 'Here the storm answers him.'

abilities.name: Right Early
abilities.from: 'He spent a career being right early and watching it change nothing.'
abilities.engine: later: also SHOW the enemy's next ability once enemies telegraph (with Berat's To See Round a Corner)
abilities.description: Marcus calls the enemy's next move before it comes. For 2 turns the party takes 25% less damage.

abilities.name: Where the Strikes Land
abilities.from: 'His notes on where the strikes land have already told him something about this coast the orcs didn't know.'
abilities.engine: live: an area effect lands on the one row you aim it at
abilities.description: Calls lightning onto an enemy row for 4 turns, striking everything standing in it.

abilities.name: The Biggest One There Is
abilities.from: 'he'd like to stand in the middle of the biggest one there is. He's a meteorologist. He knows how that ends.'
abilities.engine: live: health_cost_pct 25, and all_enemies now reaches every enemy
abilities.description: Heavy nature damage to all enemies. Marcus takes 25% of his maximum health doing it.

passives._from: 'a great deal of sitting absolutely still in the dark' / 'A year of being outclassed by pigs.'

abilities.name: Four Seconds Before It Does
abilities.from: 'She can tell you what a pack's about to do four seconds before it does it.'
abilities.engine: needs: act before all enemies next round
abilities.description: Rosa acts before every enemy next round.

abilities.name: Stop Tracking, Start Anticipating
abilities.from: 'she had to stop tracking and start anticipating. She was bad at it for a year.'
abilities.engine: live: hit_rating to the cap for the window
abilities.description: For 4 turns Rosa's attacks cannot miss.

abilities.name: Long Sightlines
abilities.from: 'Dry grass, long sightlines, big animals moving slow in the heat.'
abilities.engine: needs: ranged attack that ignores row order
abilities.description: A ranged shot at any enemy in any row, ignoring whatever stands in front.

passives._from: 'you hold a sentence in one tongue while it finishes in another' / fourteen years of sustained attention

abilities.name: Simultaneous
abilities.from: 'Simultaneous, four languages: you hold a sentence in one tongue while it finishes in another.'
abilities.engine: live: turn_meter_boost 1.0 gives the second cast; damage_dealt_pct -40 for that turn makes it 60%
abilities.description: Sophia casts a second spell this turn at 60% damage.

abilities.name: A Grammar of This World
abilities.from: 'A grammar of this world's arcane. She is convinced the thing has a syntax.'
abilities.engine: live: spell_penetration cancels the target's resistance (as Sondre's Control, Not Power)
abilities.description: For 3 turns Sophia's spells ignore enemy resistance entirely.

abilities.name: Get the Register Right
abilities.from: 'you get the register right as well as the words'
abilities.engine: live: weakest_school - Monster.take_damage uses the target's lowest resistance
abilities.description: For 2 turns Sophia's spells are dealt as whichever school the target resists least.

passives._from: 'His demons are on contracts he drafted and can recite clause by clause. He pays on time, exactly on time.'

abilities.name: Read What It Wants
abilities.from: 'read what a thing wants, work out what it'll take, close'
abilities.engine: live: dynamic_resist highest_to_zero - the target's best resistance is debuffed to nothing
abilities.description: For 4 turns the target's highest resistance is reduced to zero.

abilities.name: Clause by Clause
abilities.from: 'His demons are on contracts he drafted and can recite clause by clause.'
abilities.description: For 4 turns Ryan's demon deals 30% more damage and takes 40% less.

abilities.name: Pays On Time
abilities.from: 'He pays on time, exactly on time. That's not virtue, it's the only thing stopping the arrangement running the other direction.'
abilities.engine: live: health_cost_pct 15 and health_buys_mana - the health paid comes back as mana
abilities.description: Ryan spends 15% of his maximum health and restores that much mana.

passives._from: 'She learned to feel the bottom through the hull.' / 'the spirits of water hold a conversation with her'

abilities.name: Feel the Bottom
abilities.from: 'She learned to feel the bottom through the hull.'
abilities.engine: live: expertise removes the target's dodge and parry
abilities.description: For 3 turns Carolina's attacks cannot be dodged or parried.

abilities.name: Deep in March, Aground in September
abilities.from: 'A channel that was deep in March will ground you in September.'
abilities.engine: live: miss_chance_pct on every enemy (Character.take_damage)
abilities.description: The footing shifts. For 2 turns every enemy has a 25% chance to miss with anything it does.

abilities.name: The Same Conversation
abilities.from: 'the spirits of water hold a conversation with her that she describes as the same conversation, in an accent she had to work at'
abilities.engine: existing (heal + dispel on party)
abilities.description: Heals the party and removes one harmful effect from each ally.

passives._from: 'She planted sedge and waited. She pulled invasive grass for nine years in one basin.'

abilities.name: Slow and Correct
abilities.from: 'It is a profession of doing something slow and correct and having nothing to show anybody for a decade.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal-over-time that grows each turn it runs
abilities.description: Heals an ally each turn for 5 turns, healing 40% more with each turn it continues.

abilities.name: A Mistake Corrects Itself
abilities.from: 'the growth is so fast that a mistake corrects itself in a season and a bad habit never gets caught'
abilities.engine: needs: delayed heal that triggers on dropping low
abilities.description: For 4 turns, the first time that ally drops below 35% health they are healed for 30% of their maximum.

abilities.name: She Works the Rot
abilities.from: 'She works the rot where the corruption has reached in. Slowly.'
abilities.engine: needs: the nature damage dealt back to whoever applied it
abilities.description: Removes one harmful effect from every ally and deals nature damage to the enemy that applied it.

passives._from: 'slow start, committed middle, and knowing exactly how long it takes to stop'
passives._name: How Long It Takes to Stop

abilities.name: Committed Middle
abilities.from: 'He maintains a two-handed weapon the same way: slow start, committed middle, and knowing exactly how long it takes to stop.'
abilities.engine: live: consecutive_target_bonus - 25% per attack in a row on the same target, to 100%
abilities.description: Deals 25% more damage for each consecutive turn Ivan has attacked this target, up to 100%.

abilities.name: He Never Hit One
abilities.from: 'Eleven years of a heavy thing on rails with other people's children stepping off kerbs. He never hit one.'
abilities.engine: live: damage_dealt_pct. The friendly-fire half was removed - there is no friendly fire in this game.
abilities.description: Ivan picks his ground. For 4 turns everything he hits takes 15% more damage from him.

abilities.name: Directing Traffic
abilities.from: 'He's begun directing it, unasked, at the worst hour. The orcs have started doing what he says.'
abilities.engine: needs: reorder the turn meter
abilities.description: For 2 turns the party acts before every enemy and gains 15 haste.

passives._from: 'eight years of talking to nobody is good preparation for talking to something'

abilities.name: He Gets Sentences
abilities.from: 'The Blasted Lands, where the air is thin with something and most people get headaches and leave. He gets sentences. He stays.'
abilities.engine: needs: convert incoming magic damage to a resource or shield
abilities.description: For 3 turns, 40% of the magic damage Owen takes is converted into a shield on him instead.

abilities.name: Something Answered
abilities.from: 'something in the dark answered him, and the terrible part is that he was glad'
abilities.engine: needs: self-buff that grows while at low health
abilities.description: For 4 turns Owen deals 1% more damage for every 2% of health he is missing.

abilities.name: A Record of the Route
abilities.from: 'he has begun writing down what he hears, on the grounds that if he ever goes wrong, somebody will want a record of the route'
abilities.engine: live: immediate restore_expired - buffs that ran out in each ally's last 3 turns come back at full length
abilities.description: Restores every buff that expired on the party in the last 3 turns.

passives._from: 'the four hours before dawn when the astronomers slept and the mountain belonged to him'

abilities.name: A Sky Is Also a Clock
abilities.from: 'somebody who understands that a sky is also a calendar and a clock and a promise'
abilities.engine: needs: extend the remaining duration of party buffs
abilities.description: Extends every buff on the party by 2 turns.

abilities.name: Learning Them From Scratch
abilities.from: 'spent his first winter learning them from scratch, alone, on his back in the grass'
abilities.engine: needs: heal that grows with turns elapsed this fight
abilities.description: Heals an ally for more the longer the fight has run, up to double at turn 10.

abilities.name: Most of the Sky At Once
abilities.from: 'From the top of one of them he can see most of the sky at once'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: For 3 turns the party sees what each enemy will do and gains 4 spell crit.

passives._from: 'He has seen what high ground does to a body and to a personality.'

abilities.name: Day Four
abilities.from: 'he judges strangers by how they behave on day four'
abilities.engine: needs: mitigation that grows each turn the buff is active
abilities.description: For 6 turns Pasang takes 4% less damage for each turn the buff has been up, up to 24%.

abilities.name: He Carried Loads
abilities.from: 'He carried loads for people who went home famous.'
abilities.engine: needs: absorb a share of all party damage
abilities.description: For 4 turns Pasang absorbs 30% of all damage dealt to the party.

abilities.name: He Has the Names
abilities.from: 'Four of his cousins did the same work. Two of them died on it. He has the names and he keeps them to himself.'
abilities.engine: needs: on-ally-death trigger with a duration
abilities.description: For 5 turns after an ally falls, Pasang takes 25% less damage and deals 25% more.

passives._from: 'The discipline is a single stroke, studied until the hand no longer requires the mind.'
passives._name: The Hand No Longer Requires the Mind

abilities.name: A Single Stroke
abilities.from: 'The discipline is a single stroke, studied until the hand no longer requires the mind.'
abilities.engine: live: cannot_miss and always_crits
abilities.description: One attack that cannot miss and always critically strikes.

abilities.name: Eleven Years Before Praise
abilities.from: 'He trained under a man who corrected him for eleven years before offering praise.'
abilities.engine: needs: repeat the previous ability at no cost
abilities.description: Repeats Haruto's last ability at no resource cost.

abilities.name: Copying Them Before They Degrade
abilities.from: 'He is copying them before they finish degrading.'
abilities.engine: needs: copy an enemy buff onto self
abilities.description: Copies one buff from an enemy onto Haruto for 4 turns.

passives._from: 'The most useful thing in a burning room is a calm voice.'
passives._name: A Calm Voice in a Burning Room

abilities.name: A Calm Voice
abilities.from: 'The most useful thing in a burning room is a calm voice. The second most useful is a hand on the person about to run.'
abilities.engine: needs: fear and panic specifically (CC is not a dispel school), and the heal
abilities.description: Removes fear and panic from the party and heals each ally.

abilities.name: When Called and All At Once
abilities.from: 'The sun answers him the way a good crew does, when called and all at once.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal scaled by number of wounded allies
abilities.description: Heals the party, healing 25% more for each ally below half health.

abilities.name: Four Lines Long
abilities.from: 'He's written one. Four lines long, wrong in at least one place, and the only one that exists.'
abilities.engine: needs: remove damage-over-time effects specifically
abilities.description: Removes one damage-over-time effect from each ally.

passives._from: 'the only person in the building who could tell what was wrong from the sound'

abilities.name: From the Doorway
abilities.from: 'a plant floor she could diagnose from the doorway'
abilities.engine: needs: SHOWING the player which school that was
abilities.description: For 4 turns the target's lowest resistance is reduced by 30.

abilities.name: Forty Machines, One Toolkit
abilities.from: 'Forty machines, one toolkit'
abilities.description: Fully repairs every device and pet the party controls.

abilities.name: Fixes It Properly
abilities.from: 'She undercuts them by a third and fixes it properly.'
abilities.engine: live: damage_dealt_pct on her devices (they do not expire, so there is nothing to lengthen)
abilities.description: For 6 turns every device Marta has out deals 20% more damage.

passives._from: 'He's been envenomated more often than any person should be and files all of it under professional development.'

abilities.name: Professional Development
abilities.from: 'He's been envenomated more often than any person should be and files all of it under professional development.'
abilities.engine: live: repeat_school_taken_pct
abilities.description: For 4 turns Callum takes 50% less damage from any hit of the same school as the one before it.

abilities.name: You're Enormous
abilities.from: 'the animal isn't malicious, it's frightened and you're enormous'
abilities.engine: live: taunt on every enemy; spares_bosses
abilities.description: For 3 turns every enemy attacks Callum and nobody else. Does not work on bosses.

abilities.name: The Thing That Bites Back
abilities.from: 'the thing that bites back is the thing that trusts you'
abilities.engine: needs: reflect a share of melee damage as nature
abilities.description: For 4 turns 40% of the melee damage Callum takes is returned as nature damage.

passives._from: 'He reads weather in a sky other people call clear and finds water where there is apparently none.'

abilities.name: A Sky Other People Call Clear
abilities.from: 'He reads weather in a sky other people call clear'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party sees each enemy's next action.

abilities.name: Water Where There Is None
abilities.from: 'finds water where there is apparently none'
abilities.engine: needs: reaching EACH ALLY - restore_resource is self-only by construction
abilities.description: Restores 20% of each ally's maximum resource.

abilities.name: Six Generations
abilities.from: 'a route his family has walked for six generations' / 'he grieved the first one properly'
abilities.engine: needs: the +40% damage branch for when it is already alive
abilities.description: Returns Bakyt's eagle at full health. If it is already alive it gains 40% damage for 4 turns.

passives._from: 'The discipline is being certain that a thing will hold before anybody stands on it.'
passives._name: Certain Before Anyone Stands On It

abilities.name: Certain It Will Hold
abilities.from: 'The discipline is being certain that a thing will hold before anybody stands on it.'
abilities.engine: needs: absorb shield with a guaranteed minimum duration
abilities.description: Shields an ally. The shield absorbs damage for 4 turns and cannot be broken early.

abilities.name: Four Significant Figures
abilities.from: 'He has calculated his own limits to four significant figures'
abilities.engine: needs: remove damage variance for a window
abilities.description: For 3 turns Henrik's spells always deal their maximum damage.

abilities.name: He Does Not Approach Them
abilities.from: 'he does not approach them, which is the whole of his method and the reason he is still alive'
abilities.engine: needs: one-shot death prevention
abilities.description: The next hit that would reduce Henrik below 20% health instead leaves him at 20%.

passives._from: 'Three decades of patience with slow things, and with students who wanted results by Friday.'

abilities.name: Several Seasons for the Sentence to Finish
abilities.from: 'A plant will tell you what it needs if you are willing to wait several seasons for the sentence to finish.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal-over-time that pays its full value in one burst at the end
abilities.description: Heals an ally slightly for 4 turns, then heals them heavily when it finishes.

abilities.name: The Ability to Answer Back
abilities.from: 'Druidry asked her for the same patience and gave her, for the first time in her life, the ability to answer back.'
abilities.engine: needs: convert a heal-over-time into direct damage on the attacker
abilities.description: Ends one of Anjali's heal-over-time effects early and deals its remaining value to an enemy as nature damage.

abilities.name: Sick in a Patterned Way
abilities.from: 'the forest is sick in a patterned way and the night elves know it in their bones without having ever written it down'
abilities.engine: needs: choosing the STRONGEST effect rather than the first match
abilities.description: Removes the single strongest harmful effect from each ally.

passives._from: 'Take what's offered, give back, never turn your back on it.'

abilities.name: She's Pulled a Lot of People Out
abilities.from: 'She's pulled a lot of people out. She remembers the two she didn't, by name.'
abilities.engine: live: execute_threshold_pct 25 (refused on anyone healthier) and heals_pct_max 60
abilities.description: Usable only on an ally below 25% health. Heals them for 60% of their maximum.

abilities.name: Read the Break
abilities.from: 'The tide spirits read her the way she reads a break.'
abilities.engine: live: next_hit_taken_pct - spent by the first hit
abilities.description: For 2 turns the first attack on each ally lands for 40% less.

abilities.name: Never Turn Your Back On It
abilities.from: 'Take what's offered, give back, never turn your back on it.'
abilities.engine: live: overheal_to_shield, capped at 30% of maximum health
abilities.description: For 4 turns any healing beyond full health becomes a shield instead of being wasted, up to 30% of maximum health.

passives._from: 'the quiet conviction that a thing unrecorded has not quite happened'

abilities.name: He Catalogues
abilities.from: 'He catalogues. It is the only continuity he has and he defends it the way other people defend a family.'
abilities.engine: live: same_kind_only debuff on the commonest creature type in the fight
abilities.description: Kesten names the commonest kind of creature in the fight. For 5 turns every enemy of that kind takes 20% more damage from the whole party.

abilities.name: If You Know the Hand
abilities.from: 'the ledgers are still legible if you know the hand. He knows the hand.'
abilities.engine: needs: SHOWING the target's resistances and ability set (a UI reveal)
abilities.description: For 5 turns the target's resistances and abilities are shown, and its resistances are reduced by 20.

abilities.name: Reading His Own Entry
abilities.from: 'He has been reading his own entry for two years and has never told anyone what it says.'
abilities.engine: live: health_cost_pct
abilities.description: Kesten spends 15% of his health. For 4 turns his spell damage is increased by 25%.

passives._from: 'Water systems: pressure, pumps, the unglamorous arithmetic of a city that drinks.'

abilities.name: Which Springs Are Clean
abilities.from: 'He has mapped which springs are still clean and which only look it.'
abilities.engine: existing (dispel by category on party)
abilities.description: Removes one poison and one disease from each ally.

abilities.name: A Visible Enemy
abilities.from: 'the thing poisoning the water here is a visible enemy that can be fought, and he waited twenty years for an enemy that simple'
abilities.engine: live: bonus_vs_debuffers_pct - 35% more damage to any enemy with a harmful effect on the party
abilities.description: For 4 turns Tarek deals 35% more damage to any enemy that has applied a harmful effect to the party.

abilities.name: He Calls It Building
abilities.from: 'He has stopped describing this as rebuilding. He calls it building.'
abilities.engine: needs: persistent party shield that rebuilds each turn
abilities.description: For 5 turns the party gains a shield at the start of each turn. It does not stack; it is replaced.

passives._from: 'noticing the one entry that doesn't fit and then being unbearable about it until somebody checks'

abilities.name: The One Entry That Doesn't Fit
abilities.from: 'The whole trade is noticing the one entry that doesn't fit'
abilities.engine: needs: strike the enemy with the highest hidden value (lowest health, strongest buff)
abilities.description: Strikes whichever enemy is closest to dying, ignoring row order, for 40% extra damage.

abilities.name: Too Neat, and Neat Where Nobody Looks
abilities.from: 'leaves a trail of the same shape as a cooked ledger: too neat, and neat in the places nobody looks'
abilities.engine: needs: dealing damage for each buff taken
abilities.description: Removes every buff from the target and deals damage for each one taken.

abilities.name: Unbearable Until Somebody Checks
abilities.from: 'being unbearable about it until somebody checks'
abilities.engine: live: taunt + damage_dealt_pct on the target; spares_bosses
abilities.description: For 4 turns the target attacks only Fiona and deals 20% less damage. Does not work on bosses.

passives._from: 'standing in front of a room that would rather be anywhere else and keeping it together by presence alone'

abilities.name: By Presence Alone
abilities.from: 'keeping it together by presence alone'
abilities.engine: live: cc_immune on the whole party for 3 turns (status_effects refuses stuns, fears and charms while it holds)
abilities.description: For 3 turns the party cannot be feared, charmed or routed.

abilities.name: Stand Still While Something Comes
abilities.from: 'There's a lot of work for a man who'll stand still while something comes at him, and he took it.'
abilities.engine: live: breaks_on_attack - the guard drops at the end of any turn in which he attacked
abilities.description: For 4 turns, or until he attacks, Pavlo takes 35% less damage and returns 20% of what does land.

abilities.name: The Same Four Wars Every Spring
abilities.from: 'He taught the same four wars every spring.'
abilities.engine: live: stack_on reuse - a stack of -25% damage each time the enemy reuses an ability
abilities.description: For 6 turns, each time an enemy uses an ability it has already used this fight, it deals 25% less damage, stacking twice.

passives._from: 'His body learned things his mind never had a say in.' / 'he moves without deciding to and it's fast'

abilities.name: The Same Two Motions
abilities.from: 'the same two motions ten thousand times a day'
abilities.engine: needs: repeating attack that gains speed while unchanged
abilities.description: Each consecutive use against the same target costs 20% less and strikes 15% faster, up to five times.

abilities.name: Without Deciding To
abilities.from: 'he moves without deciding to and it's fast, and the only thing that frightens him about it is how little of it he chooses'
abilities.engine: live: counter_on_miss - a dodged, parried or missed attack is answered with a free basic attack
abilities.description: For 4 turns, every attack that misses Jun-seo is answered immediately.

abilities.name: The Lift Takes Its Time
abilities.from: 'the only way up is a lift and the lift takes its time'
abilities.engine: needs: delayed heavy strike that resolves after N turns
abilities.description: Lands at the end of two turns for triple damage. Cannot be interrupted.

passives._from: 'holding forty futures in your head simultaneously and choosing the one in which nobody dies'

abilities.name: The Handover
abilities.from: 'he has said that the handover was the hardest part... He means the handover.'
abilities.engine: needs: transfer remaining cooldowns or buffs between allies
abilities.description: Moves every cooldown on one ally to Minh, and every buff on Minh to that ally.

abilities.name: Never Letting Your Voice Carry
abilities.from: 'the discipline of never once letting your voice carry what your pulse is doing'
abilities.engine: needs: suppress a lethal blow and rewind it
abilities.description: Returns one ally to the health they had two turns ago.

abilities.name: The One In Which Nobody Dies
abilities.from: 'holding forty futures in your head simultaneously and choosing the one in which nobody dies'
abilities.engine: needs: party-wide single-instance death prevention
abilities.description: For 3 turns, the first blow that would kill any ally leaves them at 1 health instead. Once per ally.

passives._from: 'a trade where the whole year's work turns on four hours of heat going exactly right'

abilities.name: He Feels a Fire
abilities.from: 'He feels a fire the way other people feel a draught.'
abilities.engine: needs: convert incoming fire damage into healing
abilities.description: For 4 turns, fire damage taken by the party heals them for 30% of the amount instead.

abilities.name: Exactly Right
abilities.from: 'the whole year's work turns on four hours of heat going exactly right'
abilities.engine: needs: heal-over-time that pays double if it runs its full length
abilities.description: Heals an ally for 4 turns. If it is not interrupted or overwritten, the final turn heals for triple.

abilities.name: Made a Cup, Badly
abilities.from: 'the first thing he did with that was make a cup, badly, and he keeps it on a shelf'
abilities.engine: needs: what remains of the shield surviving past the buff's expiry
abilities.description: Shields an ally for 5 turns. Whatever is left of the shield when it expires is kept until the fight ends.

passives._name: Measuring By Hand and By Feel
passives._from: 'In at eleven, out at seven, measuring by hand and by feel.'

abilities.name: Everybody Gets Something
abilities.from: 'everybody gets something, nobody waits long, and the complaining is part of the process'
abilities.engine: needs: heal split evenly rather than by need
abilities.description: Heals every ally for the same amount, whether they need it or not.

abilities.name: The Weather in the Dough
abilities.from: 'He knew the weather by how the dough behaved'
abilities.engine: needs: pre-apply a heal-over-time that only begins on damage
abilities.description: For 5 turns, the next time each ally takes damage they begin healing over the following 3 turns.

abilities.name: An Order Going Out at Dawn
abilities.from: 'He treats a wounded party like an order going out at dawn'
abilities.engine: needs: queued heal that lands at the start of the next round
abilities.description: Heals the party at the start of the next round, for 60% more than an immediate heal.

passives._from: 'She still wraps her hands before anything else, breakfast included.'

abilities.name: She Hits Things and Her People Get Better
abilities.from: 'Her healing isn't gentle and doesn't look like healing. She hits things and her people get better.'
abilities.engine: live: heals_lowest_ally_pct 80 - the most wounded living ally is healed for 80% of the damage dealt
abilities.description: An attack that heals the most wounded ally for 80% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Ten Fights a Year
abilities.from: 'Ten fights a year and she won more than she lost.'
abilities.engine: needs: stacking buff on consecutive successful attacks
abilities.description: For 5 turns each of Imelda's attacks that lands gives her 8% more healing done, stacking to 40%.

abilities.name: Rules, A Count, Somebody Keeping Time
abilities.from: 'whether anybody here fights properly. Rules. A count. Somebody keeping time.'
abilities.engine: live: taunt holds it on her, damage_dealt_pct +30 on it, mark +30% for her against it
abilities.description: For 3 turns the target is locked onto Imelda. It deals 30% more damage, and so does she to it.

passives._from: 'The job was leverage, timing, and never being the reason something fell.'

abilities.name: Heavy Things Through Small Gaps
abilities.from: 'He swings a two-hander like a man who's spent his life moving heavy things through small gaps.'
abilities.engine: live: armor_ignore_pct 60, added to the caster's armour penetration for this one swing
abilities.description: An attack that ignores 60% of the target's armour.

abilities.name: Hanging Weight Overhead
abilities.from: 'hanging weight over the heads of people who'd never once look up'
abilities.engine: needs: delayed area strike on a chosen row
abilities.description: Drops a heavy strike on one enemy row at the end of two turns.

abilities.name: They Tie Off Badly
abilities.from: 'people here build fast and tie off badly and he physically can't walk past it'
abilities.engine: needs: restricting it to DEFENSIVE buffs, and the 25% armour reduction
abilities.description: Removes every defensive buff from the target and reduces its armour by 25% for 4 turns.

passives._name: The Axe Is the Same Axe
passives._from: 'The axe is the same axe. The cold's the same cold.'

abilities.name: The Same Axe
abilities.from: 'The axe is the same axe.'
abilities.engine: live: per_use_bonus - 12% per earlier use this fight, to 60%
abilities.description: Deals 12% more damage for each time Eino has used it already this fight, up to 60%.

abilities.name: Timber the Size of Towers
abilities.from: 'Winterspring. Snow, dark, and timber the size of towers.'
abilities.engine: live: high_health_bonus - double damage above 60% health
abilities.description: Deals double damage to an enemy above 60% health.

abilities.name: Six Months of Dark
abilities.from: 'Six months of dark a year, machinery, and nobody to talk to for days at a stretch.'
abilities.engine: needs: COST UNPAID: gains nothing from any ally's buffs
abilities.description: For 5 turns Eino deals 25% more damage and gains nothing from any ally's buffs.

passives._from: 'a city that taught him triage as a reflex and the bitter arithmetic of a van with four spaces'

abilities.name: First On Scene. Always.
abilities.from: 'He is first on scene. Always.'
abilities.engine: needs: move to a fallen ally and stabilise
abilities.description: Reaches any ally below 25% health immediately and heals them for 50% of their maximum.

abilities.name: A Van With Four Spaces
abilities.from: 'the bitter arithmetic of a van with four spaces'
abilities.engine: needs: heal exactly four allies, strongest first
abilities.description: Heals the four most wounded allies. A fifth gets nothing.

abilities.name: The Arithmetic, In Public
abilities.from: 'three years on he is still doing the arithmetic in public, out loud, for anyone who wants to argue'
abilities.engine: needs: self-damage converted to party healing
abilities.description: Ziad spends 25% of his maximum health and heals the party for twice that amount.

passives._from: 'A precaution costs less than the thing it prevents, every time, on any world.'

abilities.name: Exclusion Zone
abilities.from: 'Harnesses, exclusion zones, and the deeply unglamorous business of nobody dying today.'
abilities.engine: live: an area debuff lands on the one row you aim at; damage_dealt_pct is read on monsters
abilities.description: For 3 turns enemies in one row deal 30% less damage.

abilities.name: Nine Men In Three Years
abilities.from: 'Pieter has pulled nine men out in three years. He keeps the number because somebody should.'
abilities.engine: needs: interrupt a lethal blow on an ally
abilities.description: For 4 turns, the first blow that would kill that ally instead leaves them at 15% health.

abilities.name: Shouted At By Thousands
abilities.from: 'He's been shouted at by thousands of men in a hurry and outlasted all of them.'
abilities.engine: live: threat_generation_pct + damage taken reductions
abilities.description: For 4 turns Pieter generates triple threat and takes 20% less damage.

passives._name: A Violent Thing For a Good Reason
passives._from: 'The trade consists of doing a violent thing for a good reason, with absolute precision.'

abilities.name: Absolute Precision
abilities.from: 'doing a violent thing for a good reason, with absolute precision'
abilities.engine: live: always_crits
abilities.description: An attack that always critically strikes.

abilities.name: The Formalities Removed
abilities.from: 'Blood magic is the identical proposition with the formalities removed.'
abilities.engine: live: heals_lowest_ally_pct 60
abilities.description: An attack that heals the lowest-health ally for 60% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: He Asks. Every Time.
abilities.from: 'He asks. Every time, on the record, and then treats them anyway.'
abilities.description: Removes one harmful effect from an ally and deals its remaining damage to the enemy that applied it.

passives._from: 'He is unshockable in a way that has nothing to do with callousness.'

abilities.name: The Steadiest Person in the Worst Room
abilities.from: 'being the steadiest person in the worst room of somebody's life'
abilities.engine: needs: party-wide fear and panic immunity
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party cannot be feared or panicked and takes 15% less shadow damage.

abilities.name: Who a Body Was
abilities.from: 'he has used it four times now to find out who a body was before it stopped being anyone'
abilities.engine: needs: raising the ACTUAL slain enemy, at half its own strength
abilities.description: Raises the most recently slain enemy to fight for 4 turns at half its strength.

abilities.name: One Hundred and Forty
abilities.from: 'He has conducted one hundred and forty. He keeps a register.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal scaled by allies lost this fight
abilities.description: Heals the party. Heals 40% more for each ally who has fallen this fight.

passives._from: 'She learned to read a forest for the one wrong thing in it: a snare, a path, a silence where there should be birds.'

abilities.name: A Silence Where There Should Be Birds
abilities.from: 'a snare, a path, a silence where there should be birds'
abilities.engine: needs: detect ambush and pre-empt it
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party cannot be ambushed or surprised, and gains 8 hit rating.

abilities.name: A Route She Drew Herself
abilities.from: 'walking a route she drew herself, looking for the one wrong thing'
abilities.engine: live: high_health_bonus - 40% more to a full-health target
abilities.description: A shot at any enemy in any row, dealing 40% more damage to a full-health target.

abilities.name: Signed None of the Reports
abilities.from: 'She has reported every find to the Sentinels and signed none of the reports.'
abilities.engine: needs: passing her existing threat to the ally who has the most
abilities.description: For 4 turns Ratih generates no threat, and her threat so far passes to the ally with the most.

passives._name: For Once the Numbers Hold Still
passives._from: 'He finds arcane magic restful by comparison because for once the numbers hold still.'

abilities.name: How Likely a Thing Is
abilities.from: 'The work of establishing, very carefully, how likely a thing is.'
abilities.engine: live: crit_then_miss - counted in casts, not turns
abilities.description: Kourosh's next three damaging spells will critically strike. The one after them will miss.

abilities.name: Finish the Sum
abilities.from: 'the first thing he did on this world was finish the sum'
abilities.engine: needs: delayed spell that resolves for accumulated value
abilities.description: Builds for 3 turns, then deals arcane damage equal to everything Kourosh cast in that time.

abilities.name: Characterising It
abilities.from: 'the lattice does something to arcane magic that nobody has characterised. He's characterising it.'
abilities.engine: needs: read and lower one resistance
abilities.description: For 5 turns the target's arcane resistance is reduced by 40.

passives._name: Reads Sand the Way a Sailor Reads Water
passives._from: 'He reads sand the way a sailor reads water.'

abilities.name: A Wrong Turn Costs a Camel
abilities.from: 'across ground where a wrong turn costs a camel and a second wrong turn costs a man'
abilities.engine: needs: escalating penalty on a repeating enemy
abilities.description: For 5 turns the target takes 15% more damage each time it repeats an ability, stacking to 45%.

abilities.name: He Asked the Land for Permission
abilities.from: 'He asked the land for permission in his own language and something answered.'
abilities.engine: needs: terrain-based party buff
abilities.description: For 4 turns the ground steadies the party: 20% more dodge and immunity to knockback.

abilities.name: The Water Allowance
abilities.from: 'He has refused two contracts over the water allowance and both parties came back with a better one.'
abilities.engine: needs: reaching each ally, and excluding those above half resource
abilities.description: Restores 25% of each ally's maximum resource. Allies above half resource get nothing.

passives._from: 'She learned to keep a frightened person talking while her hands did something they would rather not watch.'

abilities.name: One More Instrument on a Tray
abilities.from: 'The Light moves through her easily and she treats it as one more instrument on a tray.'
abilities.engine: live: heals_lowest_ally_pct 70
abilities.description: Shadow damage that heals the lowest-health ally for 70% of the amount.

abilities.name: The Habit of Narrating
abilities.from: 'The habit of narrating came with her and half the party finds it steadying and half find it maddening.'
abilities.engine: live: damage_taken_pct -20% and damage_dealt_pct -5 on the whole party for 4 turns
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party takes 20% less damage and deals 5% less.

abilities.name: She Reaches Them Faster
abilities.from: 'the raptors take travellers and the garrison gets to them slowly. She reaches them faster.'
abilities.engine: live: low_health_bonus 30% under half health
abilities.description: A heal on any ally, for 30% more if they are below half health.

passives._name: Faster Than He Can Explain Why
passives._from: 'He can take a thing apart faster than he can explain why.'

abilities.name: Everybody Learned to Keep Working in the Dark
abilities.from: 'a mall where the power went off twice a day and everybody had learned to keep working in the dark'
abilities.engine: live: cc_immune and all_ability_cost_pct 0.3. Blind, silence and interrupt do not exist for a player character, so the text names what can actually happen to him
abilities.description: For 4 turns Diego cannot be stunned, feared or otherwise controlled, and his abilities cost 30% less.

abilities.name: Take a Thing Apart
abilities.from: 'He can take a thing apart faster than he can explain why.'
abilities.engine: live: strips buffs, then armor_pct -30 for 4 turns (Monster.armor reads it)
abilities.description: Removes two buffs from the target and reduces its armour by 30% for 4 turns.

abilities.name: The Clockwork Beetle
abilities.from: 'He has a half-built clockwork beetle that has been nearly finished for eleven months. Nobody has seen it move.'
abilities.engine: live: summons the Clockwork Assistant
abilities.description: The beetle finally moves. It fights for 5 turns and then stops working again.

passives._name: The Calmest Person in the Room
passives._from: 'The job is being the calmest person in a room where something enormous is happening.'

abilities.name: The First Ninety Seconds
abilities.from: 'Six years of her life were about the first ninety seconds of somebody else's.'
abilities.engine: live: revive at 25% health. The 'within two turns of falling' window was dropped from the text - nothing records when somebody fell
abilities.description: Returns a fallen ally to the fight at 25% health.

abilities.name: A Working Pair of Hands
abilities.from: 'What she had was a working pair of hands and a world full of people who needed them.'
abilities.engine: live: a party heal. 'Cannot be interrupted or pushed back' was dropped from the text - nothing in this game interrupts a cast, so it promised a protection against nothing
abilities.description: Heals the party.

abilities.name: She Taught Four Women
abilities.from: 'She has taught four women to do what she does with their hands when she is not there.'
abilities.description: For 5 turns, 20% of the damage that ally deals heals whoever in the party is worst hurt.

passives._from: 'The high open ground, where he can see weather coming for an hour before it arrives.'

abilities.name: Something He Had Not Asked For
abilities.from: 'the wind did something he had not asked for and a barn went over with people inside it'
abilities.engine: live: one row struck, and self_stun_turns 1
abilities.description: Heavy nature damage to one enemy row. Sondre is stunned for the following turn.

abilities.name: Control, Not Power
abilities.from: 'Control. Not power. He has plenty of power and it is the whole problem.'
abilities.engine: live: hit_rating to the cap, spell_penetration cancels resistance
abilities.description: For 4 turns Sondre's spells deal 20% less damage and cannot miss, be resisted or go astray.

abilities.name: First Awake Every Morning
abilities.from: 'He is first awake every morning and has made the fire before anybody else is up.'
abilities.engine: live: turn_meter_boost 1.0 - every ally's turn meter is filled
abilities.description: The party acts before every enemy next round.

passives._from: 'He arrived with better hands than almost anybody and no idea what to do with the rest of himself.'

abilities.name: Small Careful Work Inside a Fist
abilities.from: 'The job is small careful work inside a space the size of a fist, on a person who would rather be anywhere else.'
abilities.engine: live: a heal stops at full health, so nothing is wasted by construction; the limit is the heal's own size
abilities.description: Heals an ally for exactly what they are missing, up to a limit. Nothing is wasted.

abilities.name: A Frightened Patient Moves
abilities.from: 'a frightened patient is a patient who moves'
abilities.engine: live: grants_turn - the healed ally's turn meter is filled
abilities.description: Heals an ally and lets them act again immediately.

abilities.name: To See Round a Corner
abilities.from: 'He still carries the mouth mirror behind his ear. He has used it twice for its actual purpose and perhaps forty times to see round a corner.'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: For 3 turns the party sees what each enemy will do next.

passives._name: Watching All of Them at Once
passives._from: 'What he is good at is standing still in a crowd of strangers for nine hours and watching all of them at once.'

abilities.name: The Same Forty Faces
abilities.from: 'A route, a fare box, and the same forty faces every morning.'
abilities.engine: live: struck_before_bonus_pct - 30% more to anything he has already hit this fight
abilities.description: Deals 30% more damage to any enemy Matías has already hit this fight.

abilities.name: He Clicks It Twice
abilities.from: 'He carries the ticket punch and clicks it twice before a fight, every time.'
abilities.engine: needs: opening-turn buff
abilities.description: For 3 turns Matías deals 25% more damage and takes 15% less. Best used before the first blow.

abilities.name: Standing Still in a Crowd
abilities.from: 'standing still in a crowd of strangers for nine hours'
abilities.engine: needs: retaliation against every attacker
abilities.description: For 4 turns every enemy that attacks Matías takes 30% of the damage back.

passives._name: No Spare Words to Hide Behind
passives._from: 'His English is small and he uses every word of it deliberately... he has no spare words to hide behind.'

abilities.name: The Ground Tells the Truth
abilities.from: 'The high country, where the air is right and the ground tells the truth.'
abilities.engine: live: dodge and parry in stat_mods on the enemy
abilities.description: For 3 turns no enemy can dodge or parry.

abilities.name: Completely Unhurried
abilities.from: 'He is physically enormous and completely unhurried.'
abilities.engine: needs: forgo haste for mitigation and damage
abilities.description: For 5 turns Giorgi acts at half speed, takes 35% less damage and deals 40% more.

abilities.name: Bringing the Herd Down
abilities.from: 'Every autumn, on roughly the right day, he walks down to lower ground. He is bringing the herd down. There is no herd.'
abilities.engine: live: forced_front, read by combat/rows.row_of - every enemy counts as front row for 2 turns
abilities.description: Drives every enemy into the front row for 2 turns, where melee can reach them.

passives._name: Exactly How Much Space You Have
passives._from: 'The job is knowing exactly how much space you have and taking all of it.'

abilities.name: Taking All of It
abilities.from: 'knowing exactly how much space you have and taking all of it'
abilities.engine: needs: strike every enemy in a chosen row once
abilities.description: Strikes every enemy in one row once.

abilities.name: Twenty-Two Minutes
abilities.from: 'a city she could cross in twenty-two minutes'
abilities.engine: needs: extra action with reduced damage
abilities.description: For 2 turns Camille acts twice per round, each action dealing 40% less.

abilities.name: She Will Not Take a Message She Has Not Read
abilities.from: 'She will not take a message she has not read.'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: Reveals the target's next ability. For 3 turns Camille's attacks against it cannot miss.

passives._from: 'He talks constantly and listens harder than anybody notices.'

abilities.name: Sit Down, Tell Me What Is Wrong
abilities.from: 'sit down, tell me what is wrong, I am going to fix it and we are going to talk the whole time'
abilities.engine: needs: channelled heal that also cleanses each turn
abilities.description: Heals an ally for 4 turns and removes one harmful effect each turn.

abilities.name: He Rebuilt the Room
abilities.from: 'the reason is simple: he rebuilt the room'
abilities.engine: needs: restore the party's starting condition
abilities.description: Heals the party for 35% of their maximum and restores one expired buff to each.

abilities.name: Never Been Refused Twice
abilities.from: 'he has never been refused twice by the same person'
abilities.engine: needs: second application of a resisted effect cannot be resisted
abilities.description: For 4 turns, any spell of Orlando's that is resisted cannot be resisted on its next cast.

passives._name: He Will Hold It Against Everybody
passives._from: 'Give him a rule and he will hold it against everybody including himself.'

abilities.name: The Least Popular Person on the Field
abilities.from: 'Two careers of being the least popular person on a field full of people.'
abilities.engine: live: taunt on every enemy
abilities.description: For 4 turns every enemy holds Adrián at the top of its threat.

abilities.name: He Still Has the Whistle
abilities.from: 'He still has the whistle. He has never blown it here.'
abilities.engine: live: silenced - a monster can only make its basic attack
abilities.description: One blast and everything stops. Every enemy is silenced for 2 turns: it can make its basic attack and nothing else. A boss shakes it off after 1.

abilities.name: When You Were in the Wrong
abilities.from: 'he is the only man in any party who will tell you honestly when you were in the wrong'
abilities.engine: live: punish_attacker_bonus_pct - 50% more to an enemy that attacked on its last turn
abilities.description: Deals 50% more damage to an enemy that attacked an ally last turn.

passives._name: An Instinct for Getting in Front of Things
passives._from: 'she has an instinct for getting in front of things that predates any of this'

abilities.name: Expecting to Be Run At
abilities.from: 'The sport is running at people holding a stick and expecting to be run at in return.'
abilities.engine: needs: charge that takes the next hit for an ally
abilities.description: For 3 turns Saoirse takes every blow aimed at the chosen ally, reduced by 40%.

abilities.name: The Sliotar
abilities.from: 'She throws it at people who are getting above themselves, underarm and accurately.'
abilities.engine: live: silenced - a monster can only make its basic attack
abilities.description: Underarm and accurate, at an enemy in any row. It is silenced for 2 turns: it can make its basic attack and nothing else. A boss shakes it off after 1.

abilities.name: Teach Them to Fall Properly
abilities.from: 'somebody has to teach them to fall properly'
abilities.engine: needs: convert a lethal blow into a survivable one party-wide
abilities.description: For 4 turns, the first blow that would kill any ally leaves them at 20% health instead.

passives._from: 'He is steady, unhurried and very hard to frighten.'

abilities.name: Soaking What Is Aimed Behind Him
abilities.from: 'At the front of the party, soaking what is aimed at the people behind him.'
abilities.engine: needs: absorb a share of all party damage
abilities.description: For 4 turns Nicolás takes 35% of all damage dealt to the party in their place.

abilities.name: Told to Leave Somebody Behind
abilities.from: 'the one thing that will shut him down completely is being told to leave somebody behind'
abilities.engine: needs: reach a downed ally and restore them
abilities.description: Heals the lowest-health ally for 70% of their maximum. Usable only while they are below 30%.

abilities.name: Toward What Everybody Else Goes Away From
abilities.from: 'Two people on a fast thing, going toward what everybody else is going away from.'
abilities.engine: needs: self-buff that grows with missing health
abilities.description: For 5 turns Nicolás deals 1% more damage and takes 1% less for every 3% of health he is missing.

passives._name: No Patience for Effort Without Precision
passives._from: 'She is scathing about anything done carelessly and has no patience at all for effort without precision.'

abilities.name: Corrected in Public
abilities.from: 'The job is being corrected in public by a man with a stick and then doing it exactly right forever after.'
abilities.engine: needs: restricting it to SPELLS specifically
abilities.description: Recasts Ileana's previous spell at full strength and no cost.

abilities.name: The Cold Comes Off Her
abilities.from: 'where the cold comes off her in a way the front rank has learned to stand clear of'
abilities.engine: needs: persistent frost aura on a row
abilities.description: Frost damage to one enemy row each turn for 4 turns, slowing everything in it.

abilities.name: First Person on Her Feet
abilities.from: 'She is also the first person on her feet when somebody goes down, every time, without comment.'
abilities.engine: needs: automatic response when an ally drops low
abilities.description: For 5 turns, the first time each ally drops below 30% health they are shielded for 25% of their maximum.

passives._from: 'He is huge, gentle and very hard to discourage.'

abilities.name: Relentlessly Encouraging
abilities.from: 'The work is being relentlessly encouraging to somebody who wants to give up and is entitled to.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal that grows the longer an ally stays wounded
abilities.description: Heals an ally for 30% more for each turn they have spent below half health, up to triple.

abilities.name: Where He Can Reach Either End
abilities.from: 'In the middle of the party, where he can reach either end of it.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal both rows at once
abilities.description: Heals every ally in both rows equally, ignoring range.

abilities.name: Without Making It Worse
abilities.from: 'teaching four people how to move an injured body without making it worse'
abilities.engine: needs: suppress damage-over-time while healing
abilities.description: For 4 turns that ally takes no damage-over-time and is healed each turn.

passives._from: 'She knows fire as a thing that has moods, and she is the only caster most people have met who treats her own magic as something to be managed rather than owned.'

abilities.name: She Found a Fire and Put It Out
abilities.from: 'She found a fire in her first week and put it out, and says that sorted her head out for a year.'
abilities.engine: needs: dealing their remaining damage to one enemy
abilities.description: Removes every burning effect from the party and deals their remaining damage to one enemy.

abilities.name: Discovering She Could Start One
abilities.from: 'The harder part was discovering she could start one.'
abilities.engine: needs: area fire that spreads on kill
abilities.description: Fire damage to one enemy row. Anything killed by it burns the row again for half.

abilities.name: A Rule She Tells Nobody
abilities.from: 'she has a rule she tells nobody, and she has never broken it'
abilities.engine: needs: never striking an ally (no friendly-fire logic); not fire-specific
abilities.description: For 5 turns Skye's fire deals 45% more damage but cannot strike an ally under any circumstance.

passives._from: 'He is blunt to the point of rudeness about small things and completely reliable about large ones.'

abilities.name: The Thing He Is Actually Good At
abilities.from: 'At the front with an axe, badly, and at the fire afterwards doing the thing he is actually good at.'
abilities.engine: needs: out-of-combat party restore
abilities.description: Feeds the party. Heals everyone for 40% of their maximum and restores 20% resource.

abilities.name: Too Irritated to Leave It Alone
abilities.from: 'being too irritated by how badly it was being used to leave it alone'
abilities.engine: needs: Vuk's own +25% against it (lands on the wrong actor from here)
abilities.description: For 4 turns the target attacks only Vuk, and Vuk deals 25% more damage to it.

abilities.name: A Second Bowl
abilities.from: 'he has started keeping a second bowl ready at every meal without being able to say who he thinks it is for'
abilities.engine: needs: reserving a SINGLE heal for the party rather than one per ally
abilities.description: Sets aside a heal. The next ally to fall below 25% health is healed for 50% of their maximum.

passives._name: An Animal Choosing to Come Back
passives._from: 'the particular relationship with an animal that is choosing to come back to you'

abilities.name: The Waiting
abilities.from: 'The hunting is the part of his old life that transferred whole: the waiting, the reading of ground.'
abilities.engine: live: idle_charge - each turn without an attack adds 30% to the next one, up to 120%
abilities.description: For 4 turns, each turn Khalid does not attack adds 30% to his next shot, up to 120%.

abilities.name: Exactly Where He Said He Would Be
abilities.from: 'Out ahead of the party, usually invisible, always exactly where he said he would be.'
abilities.engine: live: trap - springs on the first trapped enemy to take a turn
abilities.description: Sets a trap on one enemy row. The first enemy there to act takes heavy nature damage and loses its turn.

abilities.name: Twice Taken Food From His Hand
abilities.from: 'it has twice taken food from his hand and twice tried to remove it'
abilities.engine: needs: its attacking a RANDOM enemy rather than the chosen one
abilities.description: Calls the hill raptor for 4 turns. It deals heavy damage and attacks a random enemy, not a chosen one.

passives._from: 'fifteen years of standing in empty country deciding where the lines went'

abilities.name: When He Lets It Swing
abilities.from: 'The party has learned that when he stops and lets it swing, something ahead is wrong.'
abilities.engine: live: reveals_intent - the combat log says what each revealed enemy will do on its next turn
abilities.description: For 4 turns the party sees which enemy is most dangerous and what it will do.

abilities.name: The Fastest Route to Being Useful
abilities.from: 'He took the fel deliberately, after consideration, as the fastest route to being useful in a fight.'
abilities.engine: live: health_cost_pct
abilities.description: Karim spends 20% of his health. For 4 turns he generates triple threat and deals 30% more damage.

abilities.name: He Has Stopped Apologising For It
abilities.from: 'where the green light makes the people behind him uncomfortable and he has stopped apologising for it'
abilities.engine: live: a fire damage-over-time on the row, and taunt in stat_mods turns the row on Karim
abilities.description: For 4 turns one enemy row burns with fel light each turn and attacks only Karim.

passives._name: Already Empty When He Went Looking
passives._from: 'He was already empty when he went looking, and he thinks that is the only reason it took.'

abilities.name: Doing the Loud Part
abilities.from: 'At the back, doing the loud part, with a flat expression that unsettles people.'
abilities.engine: needs: high-damage single cast with a long wind-up
abilities.description: Heavy fire damage to one enemy. Osvaldo cannot act on the following turn.

abilities.name: Six Nights a Week
abilities.from: 'sixteen years, six nights a week, for tourists who talked through all of it'
abilities.engine: needs: repeating cast that costs less each time
abilities.description: Each consecutive cast against the same target costs 20% less, to a minimum of a fifth.

abilities.name: Just Sitting There
abilities.from: 'he has twice stayed up all night with people who were in a bad way, saying almost nothing, just sitting there'
abilities.engine: needs: Osvaldo healing them MORE on a turn he does not attack
abilities.description: For 5 turns the chosen ally heals each turn. Osvaldo heals them more on any turn he does not attack.

passives._from: 'He hunts corrupted things the way he cut stone: slowly, along the grain, with no interest at all in how long it takes.'

abilities.name: Taking Something Apart Correctly
abilities.from: 'a trade of taking something apart correctly before you rebuild it'
abilities.engine: live: missing_health_bonus_pct 80 - +20% for every 25% of health the target is missing
abilities.description: Deals 20% more damage for every 25% of health the target is missing.

abilities.name: He Snaps the Chalk Line
abilities.from: 'He snaps the chalk line before he goes in anywhere.'
abilities.engine: live: mark - Bashir's own damage to a marked enemy is 30% higher
abilities.description: Marks one enemy row for 5 turns. Bashir deals 30% more damage to anything standing in it.

abilities.name: No Interest At All In How Long It Takes
abilities.from: 'with no interest at all in how long it takes'
abilities.engine: needs: damage-over-time that cannot be dispelled
abilities.description: Shadow damage over 6 turns. It cannot be removed, resisted or reduced.

passives._from: 'Thirty years of standing behind a counter reading a room.'

abilities.name: Defused More Fights With a Joke
abilities.from: 'he has defused more fights with a joke than most soldiers have with a weapon'
abilities.engine: live: damage_dealt_pct is read on monsters
abilities.description: For 3 turns every enemy deals 25% less damage.

abilities.name: A Running Commentary
abilities.from: 'he keeps up a running commentary that the enemy finds as unsettling as everyone else does'
abilities.engine: live: party damage reduction + taunts_all
abilities.description: For 4 turns enemies target Gianluca first and the party takes 20% less damage.

abilities.name: He Already Knew
abilities.from: 'the six o'clock crowd who never ordered because he already knew'
abilities.engine: live: anticipate_resist - reads the living enemies' kits
abilities.description: For 4 turns each ally gains 25 resistance to whichever school of magic the enemy leans on most. Against enemies with no magic, 10% less physical damage instead.

passives._from: 'He treats it as a tool that showed up and he has been learning its tolerances ever since.'

abilities.name: An Air of Mild Apology
abilities.from: 'At the front, taking what is aimed at other people with an air of mild apology.'
abilities.engine: needs: redirect damage with a healing component
abilities.description: For 4 turns Elias takes 30% of the damage aimed at the party and heals for a tenth of what he absorbs.

abilities.name: To Check On People Behind Him
abilities.from: 'to check on people behind him without turning round'
abilities.engine: needs: heal the lowest ally without targeting
abilities.description: Heals whichever ally is lowest, with no need to target them.

abilities.name: Four Walls and a Roof
abilities.from: 'Four walls and a roof and a stove. He has shown the drawing to nobody.'
abilities.engine: needs: immunity to weather and terrain effects
abilities.description: For 5 turns the party takes 20% less damage and is immune to weather and terrain effects.

passives._name: He Took It When the Alternative Was Dying
passives._from: 'He took it in his first year when the alternative was dying, and he has been paying for it since.'

abilities.name: Something Offered
abilities.from: 'He was alone, he was hurt, and something offered. He said yes.'
abilities.engine: needs: heal paid for with the caster's own health
abilities.description: Heals an ally for a great deal. Rui takes a fifth of the amount healed.

abilities.name: Extremely Effective and Visibly Uncomfortable
abilities.from: 'Behind the party, where he is extremely effective and visibly uncomfortable about it.'
abilities.engine: needs: strong party heal with a self debuff
abilities.description: Heals the party heavily. Rui's own healing received is halved for 3 turns.

abilities.name: He Sleeps Nearest the Fire
abilities.from: 'He sleeps nearest the fire. He has never said why and nobody has worked out that it is not the cold.'
abilities.engine: needs: shield against shadow and fear specifically
abilities.description: For 5 turns the party is shielded against shadow damage and cannot be feared.

passives._name: You Find You Have a Method
passives._from: 'the first time you lose everything it destroys you, the second time it is merely very hard, and the third time you find you have a method'

abilities.name: The Same Proof For the Ninth Time
abilities.from: 'the particular patience of a man explaining the same proof for the ninth time without letting it show'
abilities.engine: needs: repeated cast gains accuracy and effect
abilities.description: For 5 turns each repeat of the same spell deals 15% more, stacking to 75%.

abilities.name: Holding the Order of Things Together
abilities.from: 'At the back, holding the order of things together while the front rank does its work.'
abilities.engine: needs: LOCKING the turn order against other effects
abilities.description: For 3 turns the turn order cannot be changed by any effect, and the party acts first within it.

abilities.name: It Runs Backwards On Its Chain
abilities.from: 'The broken watch runs backwards on its chain. He winds it every morning regardless.'
abilities.engine: needs: return a target to an earlier state
abilities.description: Returns an ally to the health and resource they had three turns ago.

passives._from: 'At the back with a bandolier of vials, dosing by eye and never once by guess.'

abilities.name: He Knows Doses, He Knows Poisons
abilities.from: 'He knows doses, he knows poisons.'
abilities.engine: needs: healing them for what it would have dealt
abilities.description: Removes one poison or disease from each ally and heals them for what it would have dealt.

abilities.name: How Much of the Truth a Frightened Person Can Take
abilities.from: 'he knows exactly how much of the truth a frightened person can take at once'
abilities.engine: needs: heal capped to need, remainder shared
abilities.description: Heals one ally. Anything beyond what they needed is shared among the rest.

abilities.name: Whose Numbers Are Always Right
abilities.from: 'He is the only person in the party whose numbers are always right.'
abilities.engine: needs: being immune to healing REDUCTION (healing_taken_pct debuffs)
abilities.description: For 4 turns all healing on the party lands for its maximum and cannot be reduced.
